ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.both_tests_finite_local_admission.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [(v : FinitePlace K) → MeasurableSpace (adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ]
  [∀ (v : FinitePlace K), BorelSpace (adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ]
  (nu : (v : FinitePlace K) → MeasureTheory.Measure (adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ)
  [∀ (v : FinitePlace K), (nu v).IsHaarMeasure] (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) :
  ∃ S,
    ∀ (q : Fin 2),
      (∀ (v : FinitePlace K),
          0 < NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalCoefficient K v (nu v) ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalDensity K v (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q))
              (nu v)) ∧
        HasSum (fun v => NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalTerm K v (nu v) (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q))
            (∑ v ∈ S, NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalTerm K v (nu v) (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)) ∧
          Summable fun v => ‖NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalTerm K v (nu v) (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)‖
